rv.q: The talent was unbelievable—many of them virtuosos—and it reinforced the point of the entire show: that the music itself is the leading character in this work.

Speaking of Señor Ramirez, in case you were wondering, his book is a solid blend of truth and storytelling. The music and the legendary Cuban musicians, Omara Portuondo, Ibrahim Ferrer, Compay Segundo, are real, drawn from the 1996 recording sessions that became the global phenomenon.
